newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon says Japanese arrested, being interrogated.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon says Japanese arrested, being interrogated.

text.p: Lebanon's Foreign Minister Faris Bouez said on Tuesday a number of Japanese citizens suspected of belonging to the Red Army guerrilla group had been arrested by Lebanese security forces and were being interrogated.

"There are some Japanese citizens who are supposed to be members of the Japanese Red Army and who are actually with the Lebanese security forces who are interrogating (them) concerning their implication in some events," Bouez, speaking in English, told reporters in Beirut.
